detail.statement: forall fuel m n : Nat, lorAux fuel m n = lorAux fuel n m (no Le m fuel / Le n fuel hypothesis)
detail.provenance: CLAUDE.md Gotchas, the 'Nat.mul HAS THE SAME ASYMMETRY' entry: 'the obvious lor analogue is not merely harder to prove -- it is false -- lorAux 0 0 1 = 1 against lorAux 0 1 0 = 0'
